Detailed Description

Exponential decay UGen.

Integrates an input signal with a leak. The coefficient is caculated from a 60 dB decay time. This is the time required for the integrator to lose 99.9 % of its value or -60dB. This is useful for exponential decaying envelopes triggered by impulses. Implements the formula:
